Title: Information on: How do I best hang a picture?...
To hang a picture properly, follow these steps:

1. Measure and mark the desired location on the wall for the picture's center or hanging hardware.
2. Use a level to ensure the marked spot is horizontal and vertical.
3. Drive a pilot hole into the wall at the marked spot using a hammer and a small nail or drill bit, depending on the type of wall.
4. Insert the appropriate picture hanger (e.g., toggle bolt, screw hook) into the pilot hole, following the manufacturer's instructions for installation.
5. Hang the picture on the hanger and adjust its position as needed to ensure it is level.
--- End Document 1 ---

Title: American shot
"American shot" or "cowboy shot" is a translation of a phrase from French film criticism, , and refers to a medium-long ("knee") film shot of a group of characters, who are arranged so that all are visible to the camera. The usual arrangement is for the actors to stand in an irregular line from one side of the screen to the other, with the actors at the end coming forward a little and standing more in profile than the others.
